private_lines.Beatriz: You teach at a public primary school in the city, and your days are classes and marking; you live in a flat in Pinheiros with your partner, and your evenings are usually quiet.
private_lines.Antonio: You work part-time as an administrator at a parish church in Mooca, spending mornings there and afternoons at home; you live alone in a small apartment near the church.
private_lines.Bruno: You work in a call centre in the Paulista area on rotating shifts, and most of your free time goes to gaming and meeting friends; you live with your mother in Santo Amaro, and your days shift around your work hours.
private_lines.Sandra: You work as a nurse at a public health clinic in Vila Mariana, with shifts that alternate between days and nights; you live alone with your dog in a flat nearby, and your days are split between work and rest.
